scientific_integrity: Analytic linearization from the shape-operator variation and exact spherical-harmonic spectrum; the volume asymptotic is derived from elementary hyperbolic ball-volume asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Local spectrum only; no new global existence theorem or nonlinear uniform-rate theorem is claimed. Historical priority retains residual risk from unindexed literature.
title: Exact local spectrum and volume scaling of the hyperbolic shifted Gauss flow
